first_letter.body:
The Squadron for Santo Domingo — Decrès, Minister of Marine and the Colonies
An affair of state, Sire: a bill of your own acts, laid before you by the office it touches. Each answer is priced on its button; Not Now sets it aside; left unanswered by the date, it takes the second answer for you.
Sire, Ferrand wrote last February that he had bread for twenty days and no credit; Your Majesty called it shameful to abandon these brave men. Brest can put five of the line to sea in a month.
Historically the law of 20 May 1802 kept slavery in the colonies Amiens returned, and acts of 1802 restored it in Guadeloupe and Guiana; the expedition sent to break Toussaint Louverture's rule ended in Haiti's independence, 1 January 1804. Historically Haiti killed the French who stayed in 1804; Ferrand's decree of 6 January 1805 let his raiders sell the Haitians they took, and Dessalines marched on Santo Domingo, killing civilians at Moca and Santiago on his retreat.
FROM HAITI —
‘Slavery is forever abolished.’ — the Constitution of Haiti, 20 May 1805, Article 2: three years to the day after the law.
❧ France blockaded 6 of the last 12 mornings; the Emperor holds court at Lorraine.
❧ Britain's squadrons hold the coast: 100 sail effective against our 22.
❧ The passage: 36 in 100 to come home whole.
WHAT EACH ANSWER DOES
  Send five of the line: 500 gold (the treasury holds 6,716); 1 administrative action (1 left today); five of the line sail (45 → 40 in port until Late February 1806) — 36 in 100 they come home whole; caught, the five are lost and the men are ashore.
  Ferrand must hold alone: Authority 100 → 97 — the marshals' calm holds above 70.
If unanswered by Early January 1806: Ferrand must hold alone — Authority 100 → 97 — the marshals' calm holds above 70.

steps.laws:
THE LAWS OF STATE
Late December 1805
The laws of the Empire — what each does, its price, its upkeep, and whether we may enact it now. Keys 1–8 turn the ledger's books (Alt+1–8 while you type).
Laws are acts of state, Sire: bought once, then paid in gold every turn. When the chest cannot pay, the heaviest upkeep lapses first; a lapsed law returns within 10 turns at half its price plus the arrears.

The Grand Quartier Général  Berthier's Imperial Headquarters, expanded 1805–07
  Berthier's headquarters grown into a true general staff: one more order carried each day.
  • +1 order of the day, from the next refill
  9,000 gold to enact · 300 gold a turn

  A military train of the state's own wagons, decreed after the Polish winter: a French army in poor or stripped country draws its full supply again - while the Grand Quartier Général stands to run it.
